sites.title: AndroMeld: Android apps, files, and calls on Mac
sites.description: Connect Android to your Mac to reply, share photos, and take calls. Open phone apps in their own windows, organize files in Finder, and sync notifications and clipboard.
sites.home_text:
Start on your phone. Keep going on Mac. 
Bring Android and Mac together
Reply, share photos, take calls, copy and paste 
 Download on the Mac App Store 
 Get it on Google Play 
 Also available in your browser 
Requires macOS 15+ and Android 14+ 
 01 Phone apps Separate windows. More room to work. 
 02 Drag and drop From phone apps straight to your Mac 
 03 Calls and notifications Pick up calls and messages on Mac 
Ways to connect 
USB, Wi-Fi , and remote access 
USB cable 
Plug in a cable for lower lag in games, faster photo transfers and sharper video. 
 Wi-Fi 
Get home and open your Mac. Your phone connects on its own, smooth from start to finish. 
Remote 
Out and about without your second phone? Connect to it peer to peer from afar and grab that verification code. 
Your phone and Mac 
A bigger screen for everyday things 
 Multiwindow 
A window for every app 
Reply to a message, watch a video, and look something up. Each phone app has its own window. Resize them or put them side by side. 
 Calls 
A call comes in. Answer on Mac. 
Dial, answer, or mute on Mac, then switch back to your phone when you need to move. Keep the conversation going. 
 Files 
Phone files. Familiar Finder. 
Browse phone photos, documents, and storage cards in Finder. Copy, move, and rename files with the Mac shortcuts you already know. 
 Handoff 
Pick up where you left off 
Keep reading or carry on in the app you were using on your phone, now on your Mac 
More features 
 Notifications 
Your phone gets a message. So does Mac. 
New messages appear in Mac Notification Center. Copy verification codes straight from the notification, without typing them again. 
 Clipboard 
Copy here. Paste there. 
Text from your phone or an image from your Mac. Copy on one device and paste on the other, without sending it to yourself. 
 AI on your phone 
Control your phone with MCP 
 Connect an AI client through MCP to give it full control of your phone 
 Works with Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, and other MCP tools 
 Review the activity log and stop control whenever you need to 
 Input method 
Type with your Mac’s input method 
Click a text field on the phone screen and type with your Mac keyboard and the input method you already use. 
 Drag and drop 
Drag files either way 
Drag a Mac file into a phone app to use it there. Drag photos and files from a phone app to your Mac to keep editing or sharing. 
 Camera 
A phone camera for your next call 
Use your phone’s camera in Zoom, FaceTime, and other Mac apps. Choose the front or rear lens and find the angle that suits you. 
 Trackpad gestures 
Android gestures, right on your trackpad 
Swipe in from the left edge to go back, with Android’s predictive back preview. Swipe up and pause for recent apps, or swipe down from the top for your notifications. 
 Widgets 
Keep useful things in view 
Put phone widgets on your Mac desktop for a quick glance. Add shortcuts to open your favorite apps, too. 
 Storage 
See where your storage goes 
Check space by folder and app, and find large files. Take a closer look before deciding what to keep or clear. 
 APK installation 
Install APKs 
Check permissions and compatibility on your Mac, then install on your phone. Supports APK, APKS, APKM, and XAPK. 
Plans and pricing 
Start free. Choose what you need. 
Use every Mac feature for free. Choose Pro when you need more window launches and file transfers.

apps.name: AndroMeld: Manager for Android
apps.desc:
AndroMeld makes your Android device feel at home on your Mac. Manage files right in Finder, mirror apps in resizable windows, sync notifications & clipboard, and preview or install Android app packages over USB or Wi-Fi. Works with Android phones from any manufacturer, with no vendor-specific client required.

FINDER INTEGRATION

* Access your Android device’s storage right from the Finder sidebar.
* Drag and drop files, use familiar Mac shortcuts.
* Press the Spacebar for Quick Look.
* Copy, move, rename, and organize files without leaving Finder.
* Automatically blocks macOS system files like .DS_Store from being copied to your phone.

APP MIRRORING

* Cast your Android screen and audio to your Mac with low latency.
* Mirror multiple Android apps at once in separate, resizable windows.
* Arrange apps side by side and use each one like an individual Mac app.

apps.name: Clip Cloud - Clipboard Sync
apps.desc:
Sync your clipboard text across all of your devices. Clip Cloud is the simple, secure, and lightweight solution to copy text on one device and paste it instantly on the others.

KEY FEATURES:

• Instant Synchronization: Copy text on one device and it becomes immediately available to paste on another. • Universal Compatibility: Designed to bridge the gap between your devices, regardless of the platform. 
• End-to-End Encryption: Your privacy is our priority. All data transmissions are encrypted using the industry-standard AES algorithm. 
• Zero-Knowledge Architecture: We do not know what you copy. Our servers simply transmit the encrypted data without accessing the content. 
• Local History: Your clipboard history lives on your device, not in the cloud. Data is transmitted instantly and never stored on our servers.
